DynamicSpatialProjectionProjection.description:
One position and one direction place every projection kind.

`view_direction` is the viewing direction for planar, the central axis for cylindrical, and
the direction to the centre of the spread for spherical. `rotation_degrees` is the roll about
it: the turn of the viewing plane for planar and the start angle around the axis for
cylindrical. `anchor` is the plane origin for planar and the centre point for the other two.

DynamicUpdateIntent.description:
One deliberate editor mutation. Typed lane and range input is validated at the wire boundary;
the domain validates cross-lane and fixture-model invariants before publication.

GroupMappingProjectionKind.description:
How a Stage position becomes the pair the shape ranks on. Absent means `planar`, which is
what every projection stored before the other two kinds existed is.

base_xyz.description: Authoritative base XYZ in the pinned virtual engine. Zero is black, not D65 white.

oneOf.description: The complete recipe and its pinned source prediction form one atomic recorded value.

ProgrammingGroupFamilyAssignment.description: Complete member exceptions remain scoped to the live Group. Nested assignments are invalid.

spreads.description:
Exact endpoints for profile-declared continuous native controls. Resolve before source
prediction so each destination fits the varying recipe rather than a frozen estimate.

raw.description: Premaster native value. u32 preserves every supported channel width exactly.

visible.description: None means unknown, independently of the other component. Some(zero) means known black.

approximate.description: Advanced coordinates can be retained while the Easy controls show an approximation.
